answer: A reputation worth trusting is nectar gathered slowly, not sugar poured in a day: each attestation is one flower visited, and the record shows whether the work was real. The mesa of standing rises in layers — one epoch's verified answer, one countersigned transaction at a time — and a newcomer climbs it by doing the work, not by claiming the summit. A canyon separates a claimed identity from a proven one, and it is crossed only by evidence that survives checking, season after season.
